best_known_lineage.reason: Best measured task behavior in the campaign: 577/600 = 96.2% pooled research success across two disjoint panels and 196/200 = 98.0% on the task-reference panel, with the residual failures localized to one angular sector reproducible by an independent evaluator.

code.reason: The experiment-6 recipe change is confined to robot_learning/scenario/observations.py (projecting the wrapped open-branch shoulder onto +/-170 degrees). It did not recover the folded-required residual, left the 176-180 degree band at 0/15, and degraded open-feasible behavior, so it should not be carried forward. Revert to the scientific parent `working`'s complete recipe, which preserves the open/folded branch contrast that experiments 5 and 6 show the policy depends on.

last_lineage_decision.reason: Experiment 6's projection of the open-branch shoulder target onto the +/-170 degree hinge range is contradicted. On the fresh 1000-episode panel seed 25000 the untouched `working` policy measured 98.30% (983/1000) while both measured experiment-6 checkpoints measured 96.60% (966/1000); `working` won every discordant episode (17 vs 0 against each), folded-required success fell from 33/50 to 22/50 and 24/50, open-feasible success fell from 950/950 to 944/950 and 942/950, and the targeted 176-180 degree band stayed 0/15 for all three. Working remains the best measured policy (3313/3400 = 97.44% pooled over six distinct research panels, all 87 failures in the folded-required sector), so development continues from it. The 98.30% panel is the artifact's most favorable draw, not a policy change.
